purpose: One compact archive containing reviewable source and outcome evidence for the inclusive release comparison
reuse: Adapt Selection, per-member MANIFEST.json, source bookends and verify_archive from the completed inclusive-output package_evidence.py; keep collection specific to this experiment
prerequisites: All sixty main invocations and execution.json/summary.json pass
Completed paired builds identify exact baseline and candidate commits and identical effective compiler/configuration
All ten prefixes have a final merged availability receipt retaining successful and failed source attempts
Focused Drosophila audit receipts, tables and limitations are final
Posthoc report.json and final independent outcome review pass
Independent outcome review binds execution, posthoc report, focused audit and every final documentation file

payload_selection.include: Every bound repository source, test, panel, protocol, helper and small receipt
payload_selection.verify: Require exact path/size/SHA256; keep external binary, input and archive identities as manifest exclusions

payload_selection.include: Each snapshot.json, build.json and build log; every exact snapshot.files payload, including Cargo files, Rust source, panels and tests
payload_selection.verify: Snapshot file map equals build source_before and source_after; omit binary/compiler and source.tar because expanded tracked source payloads are included

payload_selection.include: All sixty individual invocation receipts, run plans, stdout/stderr/timing/constraint logs, statistics, product manifests and FASTAs
payload_selection.verify: Saved receipt equals embedded job without its receipt field; all captured output and execution-file fingerprints match

payload_selection.include: Initial failed aggregate, all individual initial receipts, two-sample corrected retry, merged availability, Slurm logs, v1/v2 source and both control/review receipts
payload_selection.verify: Keep failed transport identities and correction lineage; exclude every downloaded FASTQ and failed FASTQ partial

payload_selection.include: Full historical_identities.json, extraction source, original provenance and member inventory; optionally materialize only referenced historical FASTA members as ordinary verified archive payloads
payload_selection.verify: If materializing historical members, verify member bytes against invocation_evidence first; never nest the old evidence archive

payload_selection.source: compiled/source checks and focused Drosophila audit
payload_selection.include: Exact checked source payloads, all check logs/receipts, diagnostic source/test payloads, captured diagnostic outputs, focused audit results and independent reviews
payload_selection.verify: Bind each receipt's complete source map, not only current top-level source names; keep tested attempt lineage

payload_selection.source: new bundle and new scratch attempts
payload_selection.include: Remaining small evidence files, failed-attempt receipts/logs, final posthoc tables and reviewed documentation
payload_selection.verify: No symlinks; enforce the exclusion policy and list every omitted path with a reason

exclusions: External benchmark FASTQ/FQ inputs, compressed input streams and .fastq.partial/.fq.partial failed transfers
Cargo target directories, Rust toolchain/registry caches, .git and Python bytecode
The destination archive and its receipt while collecting
exclusion_exception: A small FASTQ fixture explicitly present in an exact checked-source map is source payload and must be included; distinguish it from external benchmark reads
publication: Refuse existing archive, receipt or temporary publication paths
Record every selected payload's absolute original path, archive member path, size, SHA256 and inclusion reason
Bookend selected source/evidence fingerprints before and after writing
Close archive, reopen independently, reject duplicate/non-file/unexpected members and hash every actual member stream
Require exact member-set equality and exact embedded MANIFEST.json equality
Publish a compact receipt containing archive identity, member count, payload bytes, execution/review bindings and independent reopen/hash result
interpretation: Packaging preserves evidence and review lineage. It does not convert uncertain hypotheses into validated products or grant release approval.
